# Paraglide JS

Paraglide JS is a compiler-first internationalization library for React + Vite, TanStack Start, SvelteKit, Vite, React Router, Next.js, Astro, and vanilla JavaScript or TypeScript apps.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://paraglidejs.com/)
- [Comparison](https://paraglidejs.com/comparison)
- [Choosing a React i18n library](https://paraglidejs.com/react-i18next-alternatives)
- [Paraglide vs react-i18next](https://paraglidejs.com/paraglide-vs-react-i18next)
- [Build workflow, generated files, Git, and CI](https://paraglidejs.com/build-workflow)
- [Benchmark and reproduction](https://paraglidejs.com/benchmark)
- [Quick Start](https://paraglidejs.com/basics)
- [Checking translations: missing translations, missing variables and unused messages](https://paraglidejs.com/checking-translations)
- [Find unused translations and fail CI on missing ones](https://paraglidejs.com/blog/find-unused-translations)
- [React + Vite](https://paraglidejs.com/react)
